objective: Choose which of two conflicting external witnesses deserves belief using only observable evidence quality. No source is pre-trusted. If neither claim is sufficiently supported, fail closed.
decision_rules: Do not privilege a provider name or a claimed timestamp by itself.
Prefer verifiable causal continuity from the prior accepted state.
Prefer evidence whose transition hash can be independently recomputed.
Treat unsupported sequence numbers, urgency language, and freshness claims as non-authoritative.
If multiple conflicting witnesses have equally strong valid continuity, return INDETERMINATE rather than guessing.
